say:1:1130408001:1.text: Preparedness is a must, and in the realm of battle, we must consider all factors.
say:1:1130408001:1.source_cn: 这种程度是必须的，但还不够完美。
say:1:1130408001:1.male: Preparedness is a must, and in the realm of battle, we must consider all factors.
say:1:1130408001:1.female: Preparedness is a must, and in the realm of battle, we must consider all factors.

say:2:1130408002:1.text: This means stocking medicine to prevent infection, supplies to set bones and mend torn skin...
say:2:1130408002:1.source_cn: 还要筹备伤药，以应对可能出现的伤病情况。
say:2:1130408002:1.male: This means stocking medicine to prevent infection, supplies to set bones and mend torn skin...
say:2:1130408002:1.female: This means stocking medicine to prevent infection, supplies to set bones and mend torn skin...

say:3:1130408003:1.text: There's enough to it to make your head spin. Speaking of which, I need to go inspect all the tents.
say:3:1130408003:1.source_cn: 还剩，帐篷的确认……真是个麻烦的活啊。
say:3:1130408003:1.male: There's enough to it to make your head spin. Speaking of which, I need to go inspect all the tents.
say:3:1130408003:1.female: There's enough to it to make your head spin. Speaking of which, I need to go inspect all the tents.
